helpAndSupport.supportChat.greeting: Hi, I'm Emily — your Dynopay support assistant. Ask me anything about fees, supported coins, payment links, wallets or our API. You can also attach a screenshot and I'll take a look. Need a person? Hit the headset icon above to reach human support.
helpAndSupport.supportChat.replyError: Sorry — I could not generate a reply. Please try again.
helpAndSupport.supportChat.rateLimit: You're sending messages a little fast — please wait a moment and try again.
helpAndSupport.supportChat.sendError: Sorry, something went wrong reaching support. Please try again in a moment.
helpAndSupport.supportChat.escalated: Done — your conversation has been forwarded to our support team. A human will get back to you by email as soon as possible.
helpAndSupport.supportChat.escalateError: Sorry, the escalation could not be sent right now. Please try again shortly.
helpAndSupport.supportChat.escalateIntro: We'll email this conversation to our support team and reply to you by email.

apiScreen.pk.formIntro: Publishable keys are safe to use in browser code. Every request from them is checked against the domains you list below.
apiScreen.pk.domainsHelp: Comma or space separated. Accepts full URLs (https://shop.com) or wildcard subdomains (*.shop.com). Requests from other origins are rejected.
apiScreen.pk.maxAmountHelp: The largest single payment this key can create (in your base currency). Amount must be ≥ 5.
apiScreen.pk.allowedCurrenciesPlaceholder: e.g. USDT-TRC20, USDC-ERC20 — leave empty to allow all configured wallets
apiScreen.pk.createdBannerBody: This key is safe to use in browser code. Copy it below — you can also re-copy it any time from the list.
apiScreen.pk.statusUpdateFailed: Failed to update publishable key status
apiScreen.pk.sectionDescription: Browser-safe keys for drop-in <dynopay-buy-button>. Each key is domain-locked and amount-capped. Requires an active secret key of the same environment.
apiScreen.pk.selectCompany: Select a company to manage its publishable keys.
apiScreen.pk.emptyBody: Publishable keys let you embed a Buy Button or checkout on your own site. Create one to get your first embeddable snippet.
apiScreen.pk.revokeModalMessage: Once revoked, this publishable key can no longer create checkout sessions. Any Buy Buttons on your site using this key will stop working. This action cannot be undone.
apiScreen.embedded.title: Embedded Checkout
apiScreen.embedded.description: Accept crypto directly on your site — no redirect. Your server creates a session with your secret key, then the browser mounts the checkout in an iframe. Always confirm payments via webhooks, not the browser event.
apiScreen.elements.errorNoPk: You need at least one active publishable key. Scroll to the Publishable Keys section below and create one — then come back and try the preview.
apiScreen.elements.errorDomainLocked: Preview failed. If your publishable key is domain-locked, add this dashboard's origin to its allowed_domains and retry.
apiScreen.elements.title: Elements — Inline Crypto Widget
apiScreen.elements.description: Render Dynopay’s native crypto payment UI directly in your DOM — no iframe, no redirect. Uses a publishable key (browser-safe) and your customer picks a currency, then pays to the address shown. Always verify fulfillment via webhooks — the browser succeeded event is UX only.
apiScreen.elements.noPkWarning: No publishable key found — the snippet uses a placeholder. Create one in the “Publishable Keys” section below.
apiScreen.webhook.toastUrlProtocol: Webhook URL must start with http:// or https://
apiScreen.webhook.toastSaveUrlFirst: Save a webhook endpoint URL first
apiScreen.webhook.eventCreatedHint: A checkout was created and an address issued — nothing paid yet
apiScreen.webhook.eventExpiredHint: A payment link passed its expiry without being paid
apiScreen.webhook.eventOverpaidHint: The customer sent more than requested, above your threshold
apiScreen.webhook.title: Webhooks
apiScreen.webhook.eventsLogSubtitle: Recent webhook delivery attempts — click a row for the payload and response
apiScreen.webhook.settingsSubtitle: Configure your endpoint URL, signing secret and test events
apiScreen.webhook.allSubtitle: Receive real-time events and inspect recent delivery attempts
apiScreen.webhook.selectCompany: Select a company to configure webhooks.
apiScreen.webhook.pausedManual: You paused webhook deliveries to your company URL
apiScreen.webhook.pausedManualHint: Turn deliveries back on whenever you're ready — per-request webhook URLs are unaffected.
apiScreen.webhook.pausedAuto: We stopped sending events because your endpoint repeatedly failed to respond
apiScreen.webhook.deliverPaused: Paused — events are not being sent to your company URL.
apiScreen.webhook.deliverActive: Active — events are sent to your company URL.
apiScreen.webhook.noUrlHint: Add your endpoint URL above to start receiving events. Once saved, you can set a signing secret, choose which events to receive and send a test.
apiScreen.webhook.noSecret: No secret set — regenerate to create one
apiScreen.webhook.eventSubscriptionsHint: Payment updates (pending, confirmed, underpaid, settled) are always delivered. Tick any extra events you want.
apiScreen.webhook.noDeliveries: No deliveries yet. Save an endpoint and click “Send test event”.
